name: space-platform-thrust-physics
title: Space Platform Thrust Physics
author: AutumnPizazz
description:
Replaces the vanilla space platform thrust/speed formula with a physically intuitive model: thrust and mass determine acceleration while velocity produces a weak drag that counteracts thrust. The drag can depend on the platform's width, height and mass through configurable exponents, and every parameter is configurable in-game.

用更符合物理直觉的模型替换原版太空平台推力-速度公式：推力与质量决定加速度，速度本身产生微弱阻力抵消推力。阻力的强弱可以按可配置的指数取决于飞船宽度、高度与质量；所有关键参数均可在游戏内配置。
